note: Feature 015 (FR-020/FR-021). Obligations are detection contracts for the reasoning layer and verifier — described as flow patterns, phrased as potential compliance risk, never audit-ready legal wording. Adding a regime or obligation is a data edit plus a version/dataset_date bump; no pipeline stage changes.

obligations.title: Consent or lawful basis before personal-data collection
obligations.summary: A flow that stores personal data should have a consent or lawful-basis step before the collection step.

obligations.title: Data-subject erasure path
obligations.summary: Flows managing personal data should offer a reachable deletion path for the data subject.

obligations.title: Safeguards when personal data leaves the trust boundary
obligations.summary: A flow moving personal data to an external system should carry a safeguard step before the share.

obligations.title: Consumer deletion request path
obligations.summary: Flows managing consumer personal information should offer a reachable deletion-request path.

obligations.title: Opt-out before selling or sharing personal information
obligations.summary: A flow sharing personal information with a third party should carry an opt-out or consent safeguard step.

regimes.name: US health information privacy and security standards

obligations.title: Safeguards around protected health information
obligations.summary: A flow creating, reading, or transmitting health data should carry an authenticated, authorized step before PHI touches an external system or an unguarded store.

obligations.title: Minimum-necessary access to PHI
obligations.summary: Steps reading health data should be scoped to roles with a treatment, payment, or operations need.
